skills.name: orchestrate
skills.adaptation: Original to this repository. Reconciled from the retired external herdr-orchestrator and herdr-worker skills against the horch CLI.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.adaptation: None. Verbatim copy of the whole skill directory (Apache-2.0, LICENSE.txt kept). Attached to the Claude orchestrator by name; belongs to no phase.

skills.name: art-direction
skills.adaptation: Combined and rewritten: the cinematic-ui director workflow (decisions, storyboard, signature composition before shared system) without its questionnaire, sub-agents, compiled-spec phase or data dumps; 13 directions merged from taste-skill styles, pencilplaybook presets and 6 film-director temperaments; pencilplaybook perceptual defaults as floors; Pencil canvas rules in one optional reference; a DESIGN-DIRECTION.md contract replaces interactive approval.

skills.name: brand-identity
skills.adaptation: Merged the ui-ux-pro-max brand skill, the non-image logo and identity guidance from its design skill, and the strategy and logo-concept method of taste-skill brandkit into one strategy-first workflow with voice, visual identity and guidelines references; scripts, image generation, presets and approval sign-off rituals dropped.

skills.name: design-imagery
skills.adaptation: Combined web, mobile, image-to-code and brand-kit image skills into one harness-neutral generate, spec, build, and screenshot-compare workflow; provider scripts, API setup, dials and approval gates removed.

skills.name: design-system
skills.adaptation: Merged the ui-ux-pro-max design-system, ui-styling and ui-ux-pro-max skills with the stitch-skill DESIGN.md format into a token-to-code workflow with checks; CSV data became curated, contrast-measured Markdown tables; search scripts, generators, slides, fonts and canvas art dropped.

skills.name: landing-page
skills.adaptation: Merged the felix-huber generate-and-review pipeline (run in one session, no nested CLI), banner-design, the landing patterns of ui-ux-pro-max and the landing rules of taste-skill; rewrote as a checkable workflow and dropped random styles, scripts and invented proof.

skills.name: motion-gsap
skills.adaptation: Merged the 8 GSAP skills and their examples into one workflow skill with 8 topic references; rewrote in our voice, fixed source API errors, added checks and a verification step; carried the cinematic-ui entrance map, interaction budget and camera vocabulary as GSAP recipes; dropped persuasion, duplicate lists and the cinematic research workflow.

skills.name: ui-redesign
skills.adaptation: Merged hallmark's redesign, audit and study verbs with taste-skill's redesign skill and redesign protocol into a staged, non-destructive workflow with a standalone audit checklist, safe design extraction from a URL or screenshot, and a new before/after evidence protocol; dropped hallmark stamps, logs, theme catalog and interactive gates.

skills.name: ui-taste
skills.adaptation: Merged hallmark and four taste-skill variants into one stack-neutral taste skill: rules per topic, ripgrep searches for named tells, measured hard gates and a six-axis rubric for review, and output-skill's complete-output rule; dropped theme and layout catalogs, dials, randomization rituals, stack-specific code and persuasion; conflicts resolved in ai_docs/reports/design-skills/skill-taste.md.

skills.name: ue-project-context
skills.adaptation: Adapted for a fleet pane with no human: the intro and the context section say the file is built from the codebase and one orchestrator reply; Step 1 ends by writing the draft (was: present it); Step 2 'Correct the draft' becomes 'Ask about the unknowns' (one QUESTION: to the orchestrator, unknowns in the skill's own order, [unknown] stays a valid final answer); Step 3 reports to the orchestrator; the fallback questionnaire becomes 'Fallback: no source tree' (mark fields [unknown], one QUESTION:); two Common Mistakes lines say orchestrator, and one new line forbids several questions. Step 1's scan, the 'What to scan' and plugin tables, the document template, the Deprecated table and the no-guessing rule are unchanged.
